title: Machine-learning screening and first-principles lattice dynamics resolve the most stable structure of NaCa(BH$_4$)$_3$ from a data-driven candidate search
summary: Equimolar NaCa(BH$_4$)$_3$ offers a theoretical hydrogen capacity of 11.24 wt.% and a decomposition enthalpy expected to fall between those of NaBH$_4$ and Ca(BH$_4$)$_2$, but it has never been prepared and no crystal structure has been reported. Predictions for it have so far been built within the perovskite family that its heavier homologues adopt. Here that assumption is removed. Six candidate frameworks were assembled from three independent sources --- experimentally determined ABX$_3$ borohydrides, a distorted perovskite from data-driven structure prediction, and an unbiased search over a structural database in which all 2238 generated candidates were relaxed with none excluded --- and at fixed charge-neutral composition the cation arrangement of every framework was enumerated exhaustively, 420 decorations reducing to 118 symmetry-inequivalent configurations, screened with a machine-learning potential and settled from first principles. The most stable structure is not a perovskite. It is a monoclinic framework of space group Cm, reached only by the unrestricted search, at $-$4.185640 eV/atom, 7.67 meV/atom below the best framework available beforehand; two chemically unrelated donor prototypes converge on it to 0.076 meV/atom, and its ordered cation arrangement is the ground state of its own series. Its phonon spectrum carries no imaginary mode at any wavevector the supercell resolves exactly and its relaxed-ion elastic tensor is positive definite, whereas the orthorhombic perovskite candidate is unstable to $-$2.401 THz. That contrast supplies a physical reason for the reported failure to obtain this composition in perovskite form, and the simulated diffraction pattern reported here identifies the predicted framework by seven reflections that neither parent phase nor the competing framework produces.

AI.tldr: 提出NaCa(BH4)3非钙钛矿结构，为高储氢材料提供新候选方案
AI.translated_summary: Equimolar NaCa(BH4)3具有理论氢容量11.24 wt.%，其分解焓预计介于NaBH4和Ca(BH4)2之间，但从未制备成功且未报道晶体结构。此前预测均基于其属于钙钛矿家族的假设。本文移除该假设，从实验确定的ABX3硼氢化物、数据驱动的结构预测得到的扭曲钙钛矿以及结构数据库的无偏搜索（所有2238个候选结构均经弛豫且无排除）组装了六个候选框架。在固定电荷中性组成下，对每个框架的阳离子排列进行穷举枚举，420种装饰减少到118种对称性不等价的构型，经机器学习势筛选并从第一性原理确定。最稳定结构并非钙钛矿，而是空间群为Cm的单斜框架，仅通过无限制搜索得到，能量比之前最佳框架低7.67 meV/原子；两种化学上无关的供体原型收敛至该结构（差异仅0.076 meV/原子），且其有序阳离子排列是该系列基态。其声子谱在超胞分辨的所有波矢处均无虚频，弛豫离子弹性张量为正定，而正交钙钛矿候选结构在-2.401 THz处不稳定。这一差异为报告中未能在钙钛矿形式获得该成分提供物理解释，本文报道的模拟衍射图样通过七条衍射峰识别出预测框架，这些峰既非母相也非竞争框架所产生。
